subject.title: [F6] Zero-duration spans indicate missing duration instrumentation

question: Should trajectory JSONL rows gain a measured span/duration contract, and which reported event types should remain point events?
rationale: Changing trajectory rows from event-only records to duration-bearing spans affects exported diagnostic schema, downstream tooling, docs, and transcript-derived tool event semantics.

options.title: Add a trajectory timing contract
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a focused design/fix that adds `durationMs` or start/end fields for real lifecycle operations with tests and docs.

options.title: Scope OTel only
options.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88812 own normal OTel latency decomposition while documenting trajectory JSONL as event-only.

options.title: Split event families
options.body: Track runtime lifecycle timings separately from transcript-derived tool call/result reconstruction so each gets the right schema.

recommendation.title: Add a trajectory timing contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a focused design/fix that adds `durationMs` or start/end fields for real lifecycle operations with tests and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame routes the central trajectory and diagnostics source to this recent area contributor, making them the best available owner for the schema-direction call.
